context_inputs.name: original_crossing_source_review
context_inputs.method: source-hashed original railway, jurisdiction, flagman and signal reviews
context_inputs.reference_frame: original Native map and actor identities
context_inputs.uncertainty: physical railway and exception qualification require independent review

limitations: Collision ray proxy does not establish actual driver perception or legal clear visibility.
Requested speed is not achieved speed or prima facie legal outcome.
Flagman duty and crossing signal semantics need independent saved review of original evidence.
